readme:
# Qwen 3 TTS - Text to Speech [1.7B]

Qwen 3 TTS 1.7B, the open-weights Qwen speech model: text to speech in 10 languages with nine preset voices, or a cloned voice from a speaker-embedding file. The 1.7B model gives more natural prosody than 0.6B.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Text to speak. |
| `text` | string | — | Alias of `prompt`; if both are sent, `text` is used. |
| `subtalker_temperature` | number 0–1 | 0.9 | Sub-model temperature. |
| `speaker_voice_embedding_file_url` | string | — | Optional cloned-voice embedding (safetensors) to use instead of a preset voice. |
| `repetition_penalty` | number | 1.05 | Reduces repeated sounds. |
| `language` | `Auto` / `English` / `Chinese` / `Spanish` / `French` / `German` / `Italian` / `Japanese` / `Korean` / `Portuguese` / `Russian` | `Auto` | Spoken language; `Auto` detects it. |
| `subtalker_top_p` | number 0–1 | 1 | Sub-model sampling setting. |
| `top_p` | number 0–1 | 1 | Sampling setting. |
| `reference_text` | string | — | Transcript used when the embedding was created; improves cloned-voice quality. |
| `top_k` | integer | 50 | Sampling setting; leave at default unless delivery is unstable. |
| `subtalker_top_k` | integer | 50 | Sub-model sampling setting. |
| `temperature` | number 0–1 | 0.9 | Higher values give more varied delivery. |
| `voice` | `Vivian` / `Serena` / `Uncle_Fu` / `Dylan` / `Eric` / `Ryan` / `Aiden` / `Ono_Anna` / `Sohee` | — | Preset voice; ignored when a speaker embedding is supplied. |
| `max_new_tokens` | integer 1–8192 | 200 | Caps the generated audio length; raise it for long text. |
| `subtalker_dosample` | boolean | true | Sampling switch for the acoustic sub-model. |

## Billing

$0.09 per 1,000 characters of input text, billed per character.

| Text | Price |
|---|---|
| 100 characters | $0.009 |
| 1,000 characters | $0.09 |
| 5,000 characters | $0.45 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Use punctuation to control pauses; break long passages into paragraphs.
- Pick a voice whose primary language matches the text.

## Limits

- `max_new_tokens` (default 200) caps the audio length; long text needs a higher value.
